scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:storage && npm run test:verify
scripts.test:rules: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.31.0 emulators:exec --project demo-kerek --only firestore "npx tsx tests/firestore-rules.spec.ts"
scripts.test:storage: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.31.0 emulators:exec --project demo-kerek --only firestore,storage "npx tsx tests/storage-rules.spec.ts"
scripts.test:verify: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.31.0 emulators:exec --project demo-kerek --only firestore,auth,storage "bash scripts/test-verify.sh"
scripts.dev:emulator: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.31.0 emulators:exec --project demo-kerek --only firestore,auth "vite --config vite.emulator.config.ts"
